description:
Port upstream skills.ts loadSkills() to Elixir.

Upstream behavior:
- Scan ~/.pi/skills/ and {cwd}/.pi/skills/ recursively
- Each skill is a directory containing SKILL.md
- Parse SKILL.md frontmatter: name (must match parent directory name), description, disable-model-invocation
- Validate: name length ≤ 64, description length ≤ 1024, name matches parent dir
- Respect .gitignore / .ignore / .fdignore (using ignore lib patterns)
- Global skills have scope: "user", project skills have scope: "project"
- Returns list of Skill structs: %{name, description, file_path, base_dir, disable_model_invocation}

Implementation:
- New module: OctoPi.Coder.ResourceLoader.Skills
- scan_dir/2 — recursive scan respecting ignore files
- parse_skill/1 — parse SKILL.md frontmatter via simple "---\n...\n---\n" extraction
- validate_skill/1 — name/description length, name matches dir
- load_all/1 — combine ~/.pi/skills/ + {cwd}/.pi/skills/ + explicit paths

Frontmatter format (YAML-like, parse manually or with yamerl):
  ---
  name: my-skill
  description: Does X when Y
  disable-model-invocation: false
  ---

Tests:
- Directory with valid SKILL.md → loaded correctly
- name mismatch → diagnostic/skipped (not fatal)
- disable-model-invocation: true → skill loaded but excluded from prompt
- .gitignore skips subdirectory
- Empty skills dir → empty list
- Global + project skills both loaded

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/skills.ts loadSkills()
title: Skills loading: discover and parse SKILL.md files
